entries.096e6980c7035a07: A brand offering yakiniku at reasonable prices in a suburban, open space. The securities report states that it works on offering free refills of rice and soup at lunch and dinner, and selling the branded wagyu "Matsusaka beef" only at certain stores under the concept "Special meat, in a familiar place".
entries.15a1faadb9bb567f: A brand offering yakiniku at reasonable prices in a suburban, open space.
entries.67ec23cdd89d4fb7: A steak restaurant that the securities report states is included in the Ark Meal format. The securities report states that it worked to promote store visits through menu measures such as "Gyu Tappuri Juicy Mountain".
entries.7706eb434adf2d6d: A reportable segment serving meals at yakiniku restaurants with concepts different from the "ANRAKUTEI/Shichirinbo Format" and at restaurants other than yakiniku, such as Japanese, Western and Chinese restaurants, including "Karakuniya (yakiniku)", "Kaentei (yakiniku)", "Shanghai Saikan (Chinese)", "Cafe Beans (cafe)" and "ANRAKUTEI Vietnam (yakiniku)".
entries.7ef049e96a5225f3: This reportable segment runs the restaurant business of "Anrakutei," which serves yakiniku at reasonable prices in open suburban spaces, and "Shichirinbo," a secondary core of the yakiniku division, which sets a higher average spend per customer than "Anrakutei" and offers meals in a calm setting with many private rooms. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were ¥10,673 million (down 6.1% from the previous year) and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥274 million (down 40.8%). It is carried out by the company and 3 consolidated subsidiaries, and the number of stores at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 152 (107 directly operated stores, 11 noren stores and FC34 stores). The securities report states that at "Anrakutei" it worked on strengthening the "Meat Day Campaign" held around the 29th of each month, selling the "& (And) Yakiniku Series," and selling the branded wagyu "Matsusaka beef" only at its stores, and at "Shichirinbo" it focused on seasonal fairs and selling new banquet courses.
entries.8eb1b35efc72accb: A reportable segment operating the restaurant businesses "Steak no Don", "Shabu-shabu Dontei" and "Volks (steak)", and the largest of the 3 reportable segments by net sales.
entries.94e117d24d08c26a: A steak restaurant that the securities report states is included in the Ark Meal format.
entries.960f5c033fef8f65: A brand positioned as the second core of the yakiniku division, with a higher average spend per customer than "ANRAKUTEI", many private rooms and meals in a calm space. The securities report states that it focused on seasonal fairs such as the "Cold Noodle Fair" and the "Strawberry Fair", and on selling new banquet courses centered on the year-end and New Year period.
entries.aa1677c4552d6b6a: This reportable segment serves meals at yakiniku restaurants with concepts different from the "Anrakutei/Shichirinbo format" and at restaurants for Japanese, Western and Chinese food other than yakiniku, and includes "Karakuniya (yakiniku)," "Kaenatei (yakiniku)," "Shanghai Saikan (Chinese)," "Cafe Beans (cafe)" and "Anrakutei Vietnam (yakiniku)." Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥510 million (up 17.8% from the previous year), the smallest of the 3 reportable segments. The segment loss (operating loss) was ¥16 million (a loss of ¥3 million in the previous year). The number of stores at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 8 (6 directly operated stores and FC2 stores).
entries.ae4245664a5f8f2d: A steak restaurant that the securities report states is included in the Ark Meal format. It worked to promote store visits through items such as the "Special Selection Harami Steak", and some stores were converted from the ANRAKUTEI (yakiniku) format. "Volks Adachi Kahei store" opened in February 2026.
entries.b295a450fe455aaa: A brand positioned as the second core of the yakiniku division, with a higher average spend per customer than "ANRAKUTEI", many private rooms and meals in a calm space.
entries.b87237147c17355d: This reportable segment runs the restaurant business of "Steak no Don," "Shabu-shabu Don-tei" and "Volks (steak)," and of the 3 reportable segments it has the largest sales. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were ¥19,606 million (up 5.6% from the previous year) and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥1,553 million (up 13.3%). It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Arc Meal Co., Ltd., and the number of stores at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 134 (132 directly operated stores and FC2 stores). The securities report states that it introduced table-order tablets and serving robots (serving robots only at Shabu-shabu Don-tei), and opened "Volks Adachi Kahei" in February 2026 and "Shabu-shabu Don-tei Soka Hanaguri" in March. It also states that 4 Anrakutei (yakiniku) stores were converted to the Volks (steak) and Shabu-shabu Don-tei formats.
